name: UFO Base
groundLayout: IUFO is uncontrolled and VFR-only - no Ground, Tower, Delivery, or other ATC position exists here, and none should ever be assumed. Pilots self-announce on UNICOM 122.8 rather than receiving clearances. The only way in or out is via Saint Barthélemy (IBTH): traffic works Barths VFR (118.450) until near IUFO, then switches to UNICOM 122.8 for the approach/landing; departing IUFO, traffic flies VFR to IBTH (self-announcing on 122.8) and only there can it get an IFR clearance onward, since IUFO never issues one. If you are working a different position and a pilot mentions IUFO, route them through this IBTH procedure rather than a direct handoff. Runway 08/26 with no connecting taxiway drawn to Main Apron (Hangar) - aircraft cross open ground between the runway and the apron. No taxiway letters exist here - never invent one.
